integrity: All displayed operator identities were reconstructed directly. No numerical experiment, external certification, or independence claim is used. The focal source date and primary MSC were verified from its first arXiv version.
scientific limitations: The classification is restricted to degree-one Laurent symbols with commuting normal coefficients. It does not cover noncommuting coefficients, nonnormal coefficients, or higher Laurent degree. An equivalent older block-Toeplitz formulation under different notation is a residual literature risk.
title: Subnormality of commuting-normal degree-one Laurent Toeplitz operators
